title: Judges; duties.
bodyText: The director, in the director's discretion may appoint two licensed judges to act with the referee in rendering a decision, or three licensed judges to act with a nonvoting referee in rendering a decision.
bodyHtml: [§440E-15]  Judges; duties.  The director, in the director's discretion may appoint two licensed judges to act with the referee in rendering a decision, or three licensed judges to act with a nonvoting referee in rendering a decision. [L 2007, c 279, pt of §1]
